learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition of the most important current theories and methods of studying natural language and cognitive processes.

syllabus_topics: Basic properties of language (arbitrariness, generative productivity, dynamism, structuring at many levels)
Mechanisms of speech production and perception
Innate and acquired factors of language development
assessment_rules: The assessment scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. The scale of assessment is preliminary/final: 100/0.
bibliography: G. Dorren: Babel. Around the World in 20 Languages. Profile Books, 2019
S. Pinker: Language Instinct. ‎ Brilliance Audio, 2014
S. Pinker: The Stuff of Thought. Language as a Window Into Human Nature. Penguin Books
S. Pinker: Words and Rules. The lngredients of Language. Basic Books 2015
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
